quote_text: Viv Richards has just got hit on the jaw. hogg now is staring him down & the players of both the teams. Are now watching Viv with bated breaths But all of that is the effect, Today’s story is about the cause. A bouncer, A ball, A tool, A weapon whose Aftermath - the 1 second after it has been balled That can Determine the course of an entire Match. Today we tell the story of one such bouncer. that in the end showed, a bouncer is just like any weapon…. It can cut both ways. A young west Indian team had just landed in Australia. Now when I say a young , I do mean young. Most of the players playing were either playing their first or the second tour But just a few months back the same young team, had willed itself to lift the world cup. Defeating Australia in the finals. So, this series was being seen as the unofficial world championship bout. A battle for the title of the best team in the world. Clive Lloyds with his young bucks on one side & The dangerous bowling line-up of Lille and Thompson on the other. It was to be a battle of the ages. And as the first match started, As the young bucks…playing in Australia for the very first time Took the field. they were greeted with the chants off. Lillee lillee kill kill kill. What happened next was nothing short of a massacre. Taking wickets winning the match, All that was an afterthought… What was more important was to show the world cup winners. Their rightful place. In Australians eyes, that world cup – was nothing more than a fluke. & somebody, Somebody had to be punished, for taking away what was rightfully theirs. So, The Australian pacers…entered the failed… Armed with a lethal weapon. The bouncer......ribs, head, legs, fingers… everything was a valid target. Players after players kept on falling, Screaming in agony as they fell to their knees. The test match had suddenly become a boxing match. With the batsman having to duck, weave,sway,hook pull do whatever it was necessary… Just to survive . however very few did. There exciting new youngster greenidge was so crushed by this onslaught … that he had to be dropped midway through the series… He later went on to say that That 1975 tour was a personal nightmare so painful that I have spent my life since trying to erase it from my memory By the end the west Indian players weren’t thinking of winning the match or scoring runs or even saving the wickets… They were just trying to avoid getting hit. Just as the Australian had done at the start. Winning was an afterthought at that point… west indies lost the series 5-1. but much worse than that, Australia with their bouncers Had crushed the west Indian team Psychologically The entire team lay shattered… Their confidence lost..... There kinship blown apart… & it showed The very next series As they played India at home They would be picked apart by Indians The West Indians.... were Champions no more. And it was then Watching as his team failed to save a target of 400 That the captain Clive llyods made a decision. Pace bowlers He would create a battery of pace bowlers. bowlers…who could put fear into the Australian team That had destroyed them, So, in the very next match He would go to the field 4 pace bowlers… With the same directive that Australians had got…. Forget about wickets….destroy them. What happened next.... Was a taste of what was to come for the next 15 years… It was the first step in the creation of a team that would go on to dominate world cricket for the next decade. & as this new bowling attack was taking shape. One other person standing on the side-lines. This had a transformation of his own. Vivian Richards.... Years later people would go on to say that that Australian tour Was the coming of age for Viv Richards . he saw his team mates crumbling , under the Australian onslaught.... The psychological pressure doing much more damage.... Then any ball ever ...could It was the first time, he realised the importance of the mindset… The mindset with which you play the game The mindset with which people see you. & The mindset with which people want to destroy. you And through that.... Viv would go on to create his persona Walking on the field with his trademark swagger. Leisurely chewing gum.. as he stared down the bowler…. Taking his time…as he got on crease… Wearing only a cap while facing bowlers that could knock his head off. it was his challenge…to the world at large. I am standing right here.... Hurt me if you can. And as the year passed by.... viv along with his team continued to develop this mindset. And it soon came the time for the next world cup. In preparation for which West indies once again Landed on the shores of Australia It was there first visit back here After the 1975 humiliation. But by this time Australia had secured its place as the number 1 team in the world. And even though they had heard the growing buzz about the west indian balling attack. That was against other teams… This time they were facing them - the Australians. and Standing in front of them were Mostly the same faces… That they had disfigured back in 1975. So… All they had to do…was just remind them of that nightmare And the west Indians would fall apart… Just like before… But come the first test what greeted them West Indians …were that team no more… they stood with their back straight…taking on the challenge The entire test devolved into a closely Faught match… Which most of the time leaned towards the west Indians… And even though it ended in a draw in the end. It was seen as an insult… Australians were the best team in the world at the time You don’t just walk into their lair… And draw a match… So , Come the second match The Australian would come out all guns blazing. Specifically targeting that one batsman. Who had nearly singlehandedly blasted their entire bowling apart. Viv Richards -The man in the first test. So right on the first day itself In came hogg…And did This Viv was hit on the head The player who had come to symbolize the West Indian spirit.... had taken a fall. Everybody on the pitch…Everybody in the pavilion Suddenly Had a flashback to 4 years ago… To that humiliating destruction That had started the very same way The nightmare had been rekindled. & The reaction that viv would have now It could might as well decide the  entire series… Forget about the series in future people would come to say That That half a second after viv got hit That may have decided The crown of cricket The half a second after which viv did this.... he just kept staring You may think that he didn’t do much here What’s the big deal But year later,the bowler hogg would go on to say that it was like a horror movie where you keep on filling the enemy full of bullets and yet they keep coming at you. hogg and his entire team was searching for fear in Viv’s eyes And what they found was defiance… Defiance and disregard… Disregard….For the best team in the world Disregard for one of the best ballers in the world. And this made hogg angry…. He turned and on the very next ball and balled another bouncer... The next 50 minutes would be spent… On destroying hogg in every way imaginable. Hogg would ball just 5 more overs in that match. Each of which..would be hit for 10 runs. After which hogg had to retire hurt… Due to a sprained back… he would not return back to the pitch… for nearly a year after this incident. but his one bouncer would have have a prize to pay. coz suddenly for the entire west Indian bowling line-up. a lineup that would later be known as the fearsome foursome. All of them had there floodgates opened. everything that Australians had done to them 4 years back. It was paid back in full. every hit every ache every broken bone. was accounted for. by the time the onslaught was done. The Australia had lost 2 back to back matches. West indies had won a test series on Australian land. For the very first time, & viv Richards while earning a Groin, leg, and back Injury due the retaliatory Australian response. He had went on to score 396 runs in 4 innings. An average of 96.50 At the end of the tour. The crown had changed hands…. They would soon go on to win another world cup. And then would continue to dominate test cricket for the next 15 years. But it was in this series That  cricket in its entirety learned a very important lesson A bouncer is an amazing weapon. But like any weapon, it cuts both ways. & there are people out there. Who specialize in turning your weapon against you. Thank you for watching this video! thank you for watching!
